# Version 4.151.4
> **Windows HarfBuzz compatibility** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.104/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.4 removes the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 blocker for dependent applications.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz passes BA2007** — Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5122](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5122))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.104

The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.
